title: falcon.trade_action.v1
description: Canonical candidate trade action supplied by FALCON to TRON via the board. Contract-owner: WI-B (WO-TRON-D1). This contract defines structure/constraints only; it does not decide ranking, selection, sizing or any DEC-OPEN item.

nonnegative_decimal_string.description: Exact non-negative decimal representation (HR-05). Never a binary float.

confidence_string.description: Decimal string on a closed [0.0000, 1.0000] scale, up to 4 decimal places. Scale declared by WI-B as a bounded contract-design detail (see 05-CONTRACTS.md); this is NOT DEC-OPEN-08 cross-strategy calibration, which remains OPEN.

contract_version.description: Canonical contract major version. Must equal "1" for falcon.trade_action.v1.

action_id.description: Stable identifier for this action, unique per FALCON action instance. Used for idempotency (HR-13) and correlation (HR-15).

action.description: The requested action type. This contract does not define what TRON does with each value; see 04-TRADE-LIFECYCLE.md (WI-F) for lifecycle semantics.

instrument.description: Canonical (upstream, pre-broker-resolution) instrument identifier as understood by FALCON. Broker-specific resolution happens later, at TRON's negotiation boundary (see tron.trade_intent.v1).

side.description: Requested directional side. REQUIRED when action == OPEN. For CLOSE/MODIFY/CANCEL, this field's applicability to an existing position's side is a lifecycle-semantics matter owned by WI-F; this schema neither requires nor forbids it for those action values, and its absence there asserts nothing about the targeted position's side.

stop_loss.description: Requested stop-loss price. REQUIRED when action == OPEN (HR-01). Decimal string, never a binary float (HR-05).

take_profit.description: Requested take-profit price. REQUIRED when action == OPEN (HR-01). Decimal string, never a binary float (HR-05).

confidence.description: Strategy-declared confidence for this action on the WI-B-declared [0.0000,1.0000] decimal-string scale. REQUIRED when action == OPEN (confidence-based selection/ranking applies to OPEN candidates; see 03-ARCHITECTURE.md / CAP-02). Absent for CLOSE/MODIFY/CANCEL means no ranking confidence is asserted for that action; those action types are not ranked by confidence under this contract.

valid_until_ms.description: UTC epoch-ms after which this action is stale and must not be executed (EXPIRE stage, canonical lifecycle step 3). Always required, regardless of action type.

strategy_ref.description: Reference to the originating strategy. Always required for traceability (HR-15).

signal_ref.description: Reference to the originating signal, when this action was generated in direct response to one. Absent means this action was not generated from a single discrete signal (for example, an internally-triggered CANCEL); traceability then relies on strategy_ref and/or supersedes_action_id.

supersedes_action_id.description: action_id of a prior action this action supersedes, when applicable. Absent means this action does not supersede any prior action. This field only records the reference; supersession handling itself is lifecycle behaviour owned by WI-F.

position_action_ref.description: Reference identifying the existing position and/or prior action this action targets (typically used by CLOSE, MODIFY, CANCEL). Absent means this action does not target an existing position or a prior action (for example, a new OPEN). This field only records the reference; how TRON resolves or validates it is lifecycle behaviour owned by WI-F.

extensions.description: Open, unvalidated extension bag for forward-compatible, non-canonical strategy-specific data. Absent means no extension data is attached. Fields inside extensions are deliberately NOT schema-controlled; canonical fields never live here.
